name: @khorsheed/dsh-presets
description: The three community agent presets (dev / dsh-eval / dsh-writing) as declarative `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset` bundle rows — the 0.1.5 directory presets migrated to the host 0.1.7-rc.1 preset mechanism. Data only: no runtime code, no client half.

compat.notes: Declarative preset bundle: every row is an `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset` declaration, a loader row type that exists only on host 0.1.7-rc.1 and later. On 0.1.5 the row type does not exist — the bundle cannot mount there at all (0.1.5 presets are directory-based under $DSH_HOME/.agent-presets, which 0.1.7-rc.1 no longer reads). The community tool rows the presets name (@khorsheed/dsh-local-agent-tool-subagent, -worktrees-tool, -room-tool, -typesafe-tool, -datasets-tool, -eval-tool, -canvas/agent) resolve from the installing profile's dependency closure, same as the legacy directory presets; they are data references (dsh.references), never npm dependency edges.
